tools.name: bb_get_courses
tools.description: Lists the student's Blackboard courses: course ID, course code, name, term, role and whether it's marked as a favorite.

include_inactive.description: Include courses that are no longer available/active. Defaults to false (only active courses).

tools.name: bb_get_announcements
tools.description: Fetches announcements from Blackboard courses. If course_id is omitted, returns the most recent announcements across every course.

course_id.description: Blackboard course ID (as returned by bb_get_courses). Omit for all courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of announcements to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: bb_get_calendar
tools.description: Returns calendar events (classes, due dates, exams) across every Blackboard course, in the configured timezone.

days_ahead.description: How many days into the future to include. Defaults to 30.

days_back.description: How many days into the past to include. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: bb_get_assignments
tools.description: Lists gradable items (assignments, tests and similar) with due dates, derived from the Blackboard calendar. Each item's 'id' is its gradebook column id -- pass it to bb_get_assignment_detail to get the submission status and score. Status here is 'pending' or 'overdue' only; it reflects the due date, not whether anything was actually submitted.

course_id.description: Blackboard course ID. Omit for all courses.

status.description: Filter by due-date status. Defaults to 'all'.

days_back.description: How many days into the past to look. Defaults to 30.

days_ahead.description: How many days into the future to look. Defaults to 60.

tools.name: bb_get_course_content
tools.description: Lists course materials (folders, files, assignments, tests, links) under one content node of a Blackboard course. Files include a direct download URL.

content_id.description: Parent content node ID. Defaults to ROOT, the top level of the course.

tools.name: bb_get_item
tools.description: Fetches the full detail of one Blackboard content item: its text, file/download info if it has one, and due date/points if it's a gradable item. For a container -- a folder or an Ultra lesson, which have no text of their own -- it returns the list of items inside instead.

content_id.description: Content item ID, as returned by bb_get_course_content.

tools.name: bb_get_assignment_detail
tools.description: Fetches one assignment/gradable item's full detail plus this student's own submission status, attempt date and score. Accepts either the content id from bb_get_course_content or the gradebook column id from bb_get_assignments. Does not include instructor feedback text -- Blackboard's API has no field for it.

item_id.description: The item to look up: either a content id (from bb_get_course_content) or a gradebook column id (the 'id' from bb_get_assignments). Both work.

tools.name: bb_get_grades
tools.description: This student's grades for one Blackboard course: every gradebook column with its score, points possible, and whether it's been released. A course whose gradebook the API refuses to show comes back as a clear error rather than a crash.

include_ungraded.description: Include gradebook columns with no score yet. Defaults to false (only graded columns).
